data.title: bn-r3b: inspect scoped coordination metadata without native calls
data.description: Read-only show and list projections on production SQLite snapshots. Exact range verified with offline just check and syscall, subprocess and credential witnesses. Workspace binding, finding status and recorded diagnostics await their sources.

data.body: [HIGH] The stock CLI always dispatches with no binding. As a result, every valid show or list invocation returns WORKSPACE_UNBOUND with exit 3, even with an explicit workspace selector. The process suite reaches SQLite only in its separate test executable through a closure supplying synthetic resolved paths. Integrate the approved operator binding from bn-dip and run the traffic, subprocess, and watched-file witnesses around the stock executable in both scopes. Assert that guarded bound commands return the seeded projections so the evidence verifies the normal entry point.

[HIGH] The bn-r3b acceptance explicitly includes read-only doctor with recorded diagnostic ages and an indication of missing results. At this target doctor is absent from the CLI. The executable returns USAGE_ERROR with exit 2, and the no-traffic witness never calls it. Add the scoped recorded-diagnostics read with an explicit blocker when the source is unavailable and cover populated and missing results under the read guard. The absence of this view leaves the KEEP acceptance open.

data.reason: At 8bc1454038911fcf880936b45ccd68c09ad2884c the stock executable cannot reach bound show/list and the required recorded doctor view is absent. Focused process and full offline just check passed, including the fixture-bound SQLite guard and its three positive controls. See th-1h7bc1 and th-3hcqua for the production entry-point and acceptance gaps.

data.body: Fixed at 9516449e8b770f1af765ccb7000114f76e8d5b64. Doctor reads the latest audited results for the five named checks in one SQLite snapshot, reports stable whole-second ages, typed failures and missing results, and reports an explicit capability blocker on an older source. A fixed-clock store-backed process suite covers old and future observations, malformed rows, all output formats and bounded IDs. The guarded populated and empty commands preserve the database, WAL, evidence file and revision; all guard positive controls and full offline just check passed.

[MEDIUM] Verified the new passive doctor grammar, scoped reads, fixed-clock ages, old-schema blocker, audited write tests, and populated/empty guard cases. Focused and full offline checks passed. Two diagnostic correctness gaps keep this thread open. (1) crates/scourge/src/lib.rs:344 emits events only from the command context. A seeded failure with R-review/rk_review has both IDs in the stdout check but null IDs in the stderr event, contrary to plan §11.4. Emit each event with its own bounded check correlation and assert both IDs in the process test. (2) crates/scourge-core/src/store/checks.rs:102 and :179 accept a null code with an explicit nonzero exit, and crates/scourge/src/doctor.rs:80 projects it as passed. A fixture with native_exit 7 and no code reproduced this. Refuse or normalize contradictory observations at write and read boundaries, preserving legitimate typed failures where exits are zero or absent.

data.reason: At 9516449e8b770f1af765ccb7000114f76e8d5b64, th-1h7bc1 still blocks the stock CLI entry point. Doctor exists and its read guard passes, but th-3hcqua remains open because seeded failures lose known run/request IDs on stderr and a contradictory stored nonzero exit can render as passed. Focused and full offline checks passed.

data.body: Fixed at 2628e529ea0f1aec5c23948df8dbae74e84ce431 on 1eedb65fe771c5fea298f0bca2bb0e7081607020. The stock executable resolves the independent binding and engagement before opening .scourge/state.sqlite3. Guarded stock processes return exact seeded show/list/doctor projections in bound scope and WORKSPACE_UNBOUND from hostile nested config. Positive controls trip the network, subprocess and credential guards. DB, WAL, SHM, evidence and revision remain unchanged. Tests also cover private atomic provisioning, init/add retries, symlinks and foreign database UUIDs, two engagements, and pending database-only rows without binding authority. Focused and full offline checks passed.

Fixed at 2628e529ea0f1aec5c23948df8dbae74e84ce431. Two recorded failures in one stock doctor invocation emit distinct run_id/request_key pairs on stderr matching their checks. Bounded correlation is withheld in both channels for oversized IDs. A missing diagnostic code with any nonzero native or wrapper exit is refused by the typed writer, check constraint and read integrity validation. Corrupted rows return INTEGRITY_FAILURE in stock processes and cannot render as passed. Valid typed failures with zero or absent exits, snapshot ages, redaction and read-only guards remain covered. Focused and full offline checks passed.

Final exact target 797d6bba4e560900edc2e9f42385f0661a4c3a0b on 152435b2ed939ce0d19adb1b232e216e063e03bb. The normal parallel offline full check, focused CLI/core, and guarded stock process tests passed after the launcher fix merged. The stock binding resolves .scourge/state.sqlite3 with scoped authority. Fresh zero, an idle WAL writer, first write, reopen and overlapping startup are covered. Missing, truncated, malformed, foreign-type and symlink sidecars fail integrity without repair. Ordinary reads preserve database, WAL and SHM bytes and identities and issue no application writes. The ADR records the shared-custody limit for a concurrent same-account file or journal-mode change.

Final exact target 797d6bba4e560900edc2e9f42385f0661a4c3a0b passes normal parallel full just check and the focused/guarded process suite on 152435b. Stock doctor emits separate bounded run/key correlation for distinct observations and rejects null-code nonzero exits as integrity errors. The concurrent writer failure captured SQLite primary 8, extended 264 (READONLY_RECOVERY). Snapshot acquisition now retries documented transient WAL states before projecting one snapshot. Retry exhaustion returns CONFLICTING_RUN and ordinary stock guarded doctor completed the bounded concurrent-writer probe without false integrity failures. No adapter or credential/network activity occurred.

data.reason: Verified the stock executable uses the validated binding and private workspace store. Guarded seeded and unbound processes, startup and idle WAL cases, and the sidecar integrity fixtures passed. Read-only byte and inode preservation is qualified for cooperating shared-custody processes as documented.

Verified per-observation bounded stderr correlation and typed integrity failure for contradictory outcomes. The stock doctor produced coherent snapshots in independent paced and bounded unpaced WAL writer probes. The unit and guarded cases cover transient retry and corrupted sidecars separately.

Reviewed 797d6bba4e560900edc2e9f42385f0661a4c3a0b over 152435b2ed939ce0d19adb1b232e216e063e03bb. Exact diff check, 111 core tests, focused stock CLI and process guards, and normal parallel offline just check passed. Two independent 80-read WAL writer probes each observed coherent stock doctor snapshots with no false integrity failures. The ADR documents the shared-custody limit on concurrent same-account file replacement.
